description: Whether a country bans publishing opinion polls before a vote, checked now: verdict ban / no-ban / exit-polls-only / unverified, when a ban starts and ends (polls close), whether it is in force, the law and article, and the official text it was read in. Answers "Can I publish a poll in Spain this week?" or "When does the poll blackout end in Serbia?". Give an election id, or a country for its next vote. "unverified" means we hold no verified rule: it is not a finding that polls are allowed. Not legal advice.

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "Austria" or "AT", "United States" or "US"; answers for its next election

name: poll_blackout

meta.description: What this answer was built from; cite dataset_version

ends_at.description: When it ends: the last polls close (UTC ISO)

ends_at_local.description: The same in local time, with offset

in_force.description: A verified ban applies right now

rule.description: The rule as recorded: law, citation, official source, scope, verified_at, legal detail

verdict.description: ban, no-ban, exit-polls-only, or unverified (no verified rule: not a finding that polls are allowed)

title: Can polls be published before this election?
